question: Find the volume of a hemisphere whose diameter is 7 cm. (Take π = 22/7) (Rounded up to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a hemisphere is calculated directly using the formula V = ²/₃ × π × r³.

Given the diameter is 7 cm, the radius is ⁷/₂ cm.

V = ²/₃ × ²²/₇ × (⁷/₂)³

V = ⁵³⁹/₆ = 89.833... cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 89.83 cm³.**
